name: tessaridb
description: Plugins that let an agent work with TessariDB: the database, its cluster, TessariDB S3 and the TessariKV engine, and the agent memory that keeps what a session learns.

plugins.name: tessaridb-agent-memory
plugins.description: Agent memory on TessariDB: stand the store and the memory service up locally, register the memory server, and carry the skill that says how to use it.

plugins.name: tessaridb
plugins.description: Work with TessariDB: write TessariQL, design stores across its engines, connect the clients, run a node or a cluster, run TessariDB S3 alone or as an erasure-coded cluster, run TessariDB OAuth on one server or across regions, and embed the TessariKV engine, without the mistakes that succeed quietly.
